biography_english:
A Galgastani who leads the Knights of Galgastan.
  He served directly under Balbatos, hunting down the Hierophant's enemies at home and suppressing the Walister.
  He was charged with leading an offensive against the Resistance at Psonji. Following the battle he learned that Coritanae Keep had fallen and the Hierophant was no more. He has now recaptured Almorica Castle, and continues to fight back.
biography_spanish:
Un Galgastani que lidera los Caballeros de Galgastan.
  Sirvio directamente a Balbatos, cazando a los enemigos del Hierofante en su tierra y reprimiendo a los Walister.
  Se le encargo liderar una ofensiva contra la Resistencia en Psonji. Tras la batalla supo que el Castillo de Coritanae habia caido y el Jerarca habia muerto. Ahora ha recuperado el Castillo de Almorica y continua luchando.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once led the Knights of Galgastan.
  He served directly under Balbatos, hunting down the Hierophant's enemies at home and suppressing the Walister.
  Upon the Hierophant's passing, he advanced on Almorica Castle with his troops. Fighting to the bitter end, he died in a skirmish with {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Un Galgastani que lidero los Caballeros de Galgastan.
  Sirvio  a Balbatos, cazando a los enemigos del Hierofante en su tierra y reprimiendo a los Walister.
  Tras la muerte del Hierofante, avanzo al Castillo de Almorica con sus tropas. Luchando hasta el final, murio en una escaramuza con {hero}.

biography_spanish: Un antiguo abuna que era padre de {hero}. Fue capturado durante el ataque de Loslorien a Golyat. Se cree que fue asesinado a sus manos.

biography_english:
A former abuna who is father to {hero}. He was the younger brother of Regent Brantyn, his true name Prancet Morne.
  He took in the illegitimate child of King Dorgalua born to the Queen's handmaiden Mannaflora, raising her as his own daughter, Catiua. He assumed the name Pavel to hide his connection to Brantyn.
  The Dark Knights carried him off during their attack on Golyat. They held him captive at Heim in an attempt to gain information regarding King Dorgalua's heir.
  He was released and taken in by the Order of Philaha after the princess came forward, but the serum used during his questioning left him on death's door. Before taking his last breath, he spoke to {hero} of Catiua's past and the path that lay before him.
biography_spanish:
Un antiguo abuna que es padre de {hero}. Era el hermano menor del Regente Brantyn, su nombre real Prancet Morne.
  Acogio a la hija ilegitima del Rey Dorgalua y la sirvienta de la reina Mannaflora, criandola como su propia hija, Catiua. Asumio el nombre Pavel para ocultar su lazo con Brantyn.
  Los Caballeros Oscuros se lo llevaron durante su ataque a Golyat. Lo mantuvieron cautivo en Heim para obtener informacion sobre el heredero del Rey Dorgalua.
  Fue liberado y acogido por la Orden de Philaha tras revelarse la princesa, pero el suero usado en su interrogatorio lo dejo a las puertas de la muerte. Antes de dar su ultimo aliento, hablo con {hero} sobre el pasado de Catiua y el camino ante el.

biography_english: A person sought by the Dark Knights Loslorien. Why they seek this person remains shrouded in mystery.
biography_spanish: Una persona buscada por los Caballeros Oscuros Loslorien. El por que sigue envuelto en el misterio.

biography_english: A Bakram who was mother to Catiua. Catiua was conceived after Mannaflora caught the eye of King Dorgalua while serving as handmaiden to Queen Vernotta. She was forced to flee after incurring the wrath of the queen. She died after giving birth to Catiua.
biography_spanish: Una Bakram que fue madre de Catiua. Catiua fue concebida tras Mannaflora llamar la atencion del Rey Dorgalua siendo sirvienta de la Reina Vernotta. Se vio obligada a huir tras desatar la ira de la reina y murio tras dar a luz a Catiua.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once ruled the Kingdom of Brigantys. Before the reign of King Dorgalua he fought at Dorgalua's side to unify Valeria, but they ended up mortal enemies.
  Rodrick defeated his foes with powerful magic that bent the very laws of nature, but so horrible was the destruction he wrought that his own people fled from him in terror. He was eventually brought to justice by King Dorgalua, and died in captivity.
biography_spanish:
Un Galgastani que goberno el Reino de Brigantys. Antes del reinado del Rey Dorgalua lucho a su lado para unificar Valeria, pero terminaron siendo enemigos mortales.
  Rodrick derroto a sus rivales con poderosa magia que altero las leyes naturales, pero la destruccion que causo hizo que su pueblo huyera aterrorizado. Al final el Rey Dorgalua lo llevo ante la justicia y murio en cautiverio.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once ruled the Kingdom of Brigantys. Before the reign of King Dorgalua he fought at Dorgalua's side to unify Valeria, but they ended up mortal enemies.
  Rodrick defeated his foes with powerful magic that bent the very laws of nature, but so horrible was the destruction he wrought that his own people fled from him in terror. He was eventually brought to justice by King Dorgalua, and died in captivity.
  His soul was sealed within the Chaos Gate at the Palace of the Dead, transforming him into a demonic revenant. He emerged from the gate once more when it was opened by {hero}, but was sent back to the Abyss.
biography_spanish:
Un Galgastani que goberno el Reino de Brigantys. Antes del reinado del Rey Dorgalua lucho a su lado para unificar Valeria, pero terminaron siendo enemigos mortales.
  Rodrick derroto a sus rivales con poderosa magia que altero las leyes naturales, pero la destruccion que causo hizo que su pueblo huyera aterrorizado. Al final el Rey Dorgalua lo llevo ante la justicia y murio en cautiverio.
  Su alma fue sellada en la Puerta del Caos del Palacio de los Muertos, transformandolo en un espectro demoniaco. Surgio de la puerta una vez mas cuando la abrio {hero}, pero fue enviado de vuelta al Abismo.

biography_english:
Ruler of the Kingdom of New Xenobia. He was one of the principal architects of the revolution that overthrew the Sacred Xytegenian Empire that ruled Xytegenia. After the revolution ended, he was crowned ruler of the Kingdom of New Xenobia. He is a popular king, and a skilled politician.
  After the sword Brynhildr was stolen, he sent Lanselot Hamilton and four others to Valeria to retrieve it.
biography_spanish:
Gobernante del Reino de Nueva Xenobia. Fue uno de los principales arquitectos de la revolucion que derroco al Sagrado Imperio Xytegenio que gobernaba Xytegenia. Tras el fin de la revolucion, fue coronado soberano del Reino de Nueva Xenobia. Es un rey popular y un habil politico.
  Tras el robo de la espada Brynhildr, envio a Lanselot Hamilton y a otros cuatro a Valeria para recuperarla.

biography_english: A Bakram from Heim who was once Archiereus of the Order of Philaha in the Kingdom of Valeria. He left Heim after being ousted by Exarch Brantyn. He continued to travel the lands spreading the word of Philaha, but went missing at the outbreak of war.
biography_spanish: Un Bakram de Heim que fue arcipreste de la Orden de Philaha en el Reino de Valeria. Dejo Heim tras ser expulsado por el exarca Brantyn. Continuo viajando por las tierras difundiendo la palabra de Philaha, pero desaparecio al estallar la guerra.

biography_english:
A Bakram from Heim who was once Archiereus of the Order of Philaha in the Kingdom of Valeria. He left Heim after being ousted by Exarch Brantyn. He continued to travel the lands spreading the word of Philaha, but suffered a crisis of faith after the death of his wife, and went off alone.
  He joined the Resistance after {hero} convinced him to help end the war.
biography_spanish:
Un Bakram de Heim que fue arcipreste de la Orden de Philaha en el Reino de Valeria. Dejo Heim tras ser expulsado por el exarca Brantyn. Continuo viajando para difundir la palabra de Philaha, pero sufrio una crisis de fe tras la muerte de su esposa y se marcho solo.
  Se unio a la Resistencia tras ser convencido por {hero} de ayudar a terminar la guerra.

biography_english:
A Bakram who was queen consort to the Dynast-King. She was born into the noble House Eltynaha, and the King took her as his queen upon uniting Valeria under his rule. After learning her handmaiden Mannaflora was with child by the King, Vernotta had her exiled.
  She later bore the King a son, but the child perished in an accident. The distraught Queen was beset by illness, and passed away at the tender age of 30.
biography_spanish:
Una Bakram que fue reina consorte del Rey Dinasta. Nacio en la noble Casa Eltynaha y el Rey la tomo por reina al unificar Valeria bajo su mandato. Tras saber que su sirvienta Mannaflora esperaba un hijo del Rey, Vernotta la exilio.
  Mas tarde le dio un hijo al Rey, pero este perecio en un accidente. La afligida Reina sufrio una enfermedad y murio a la temprana edad de 30.
